description: This file defines the KilocodeEventProcessor class responsible for handling and processing Kilocode stream events, managing session messages, and coordinating state machine transitions in a webview context.

classes.name: KilocodeEventProcessor
classes.description: Main class for processing Kilocode stream events, managing session messages, and triggering state transitions.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes incoming Kilocode stream events, updates session messages, and triggers state events.

methods.name: sendStateEventForMessage
methods.description: Determines and sends appropriate state events based on the payload type and content.

methods.name: deriveMessageText
methods.description: Generates message text from payload content, text, or metadata, handling special cases like checkpoints and command outputs.

methods.name: formatToolAskText
methods.description: Formats a string describing a tool ask based on metadata.

methods.name: getMessageKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for deduplicating messages, especially command outputs.
